# Anthropic Zeta-23 Source Snapshot

Retrieved: 2026-08-10

This directory preserves the two source documents used by the local
Weil/rank-trace density-bridge audit.  They are external research inputs, not
results produced by this workspace.

The result was newly released on the retrieval date.  The local audit checks
the statement, constants, central finite-dimensional inequality, and logical
interface with the RH programme.  It does not claim an independent reproof of
all analytic estimates in the paper or settled community acceptance.
